_about: C1 multi-source: SSLW versions of the cleanly-comparable overlap classes (HX area, compressor power) alongside Turton, so blended_purchased_cost can report a value + inter-source range. Vessel/pump are NOT multi-sourced here — SSLW costs them on incompatible bases (vessel by weight from D+L; pump by size-factor Q*sqrt(H)), so a same-size blend isn't apples-to-apples (documented limitation).

equipment_correlations.notes: SSLW cost_heat_exchanger floating_head: base = exp(11.9052 - 0.8709*ln(A_ft2*1.1) + 0.09005*ln^2(...)) @ CE500. Second source for HX (cross-check vs Turton).
SSLW cost_compressor centrifugal: base = exp(7.58 + 0.8*ln(work_hp)) @ CE500. Second source for compressor.
